question_text: How does the Decorator pattern maintain transparency for client code interacting with wrapped components?

options.text: By inheriting from the concrete implementation class
By implementing the exact same interface or abstract type as the component it wraps and delegating calls
By modifying the wrapped object's memory bytecode at runtime

answer_explanation: The Decorator implements the same interface as the target component and holds a reference to it, allowing callers to invoke standard methods without knowing decoration occurred.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: B. Rationale: The Decorator implements the same interface as the target component and holds a reference to it, allowing callers to invoke standard methods without knowing decoration occurred.

criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.description: Selects the exact correct technical option.
